scripts.dev: concurrently -c auto "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: sh -c 'cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${API_PORT:-8000}'
scripts.build: npm run check:api && npm run build:web
scripts.check:api: cd apps/api && python3.11 -m py_compile $(find app -name '*.py' | sort)
scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && npm run check:api
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
